name: POST /api/dialer/campaigns/:campaign_id/contacts - Upload a batch of contacts
description: Upserts 1-1000 contacts by external_ref (95b9060e-9695-45f9-a970-323d68d6a444#AC1 — upload contacts in batches). Each: external_ref (the consumer's id, 1-200), phone_number (E.164), optional subject_ref, crm_encounter_id (uuid), person_id (sdk-consent person whose ai_voice_outbound consent the dialer checks), jurisdiction (US, US-CA, GB …; default = the number's country), timezone (IANA; else the campaign default), context (JSON <= 32 KB). Re-sending a batch refreshes details without duplicating people or resetting a contact already worked. Invalid rows are rejected individually and reported by index with a reason; valid rows land. Returns {inserted, updated, rejected[], progress}. Every status change emits voice.campaign.progressed.v1 {campaign_id, agent_id, status, trigger, total, by_status} (95b9060e-9695-45f9-a970-323d68d6a444#AC2 — campaign progress is emitted as voice.campaign.progressed.v1); contact uploads emit it at most once per DIALER_PROGRESS_THROTTLE_MS (default 5 s) per campaign. A cancelled or completed campaign is 409.

testCases.name: Upload a batch with one invalid row

errorCases.message: contacts must be an array of 1-1000 entries
errorCases.when: batch missing, empty or too large

errorCases.message: campaign is cancelled; contacts can no longer be added
